A 9:16 video at 1080x1920 exceeds the stated 1200x1900 portrait max, so render vertical at 1080x1900 or less (e.g. 1068x1900) for web upload; the app may accept 1080x1920. File types: the help page doesn't list them; MP4/MOV comes from the ads page. Standard posts: 280 characters; Premium subscribers can post up to 25,000 (X Premium page; one section of the How to post page still says 4,000, which is stale). Each link counts as 23 characters. Media does not count toward the limit.
